# Application Insights — Customer Usage Journey
Analyze synthetic customers across page views, business events, funnel conversion, support escalation, A/B variants, and repeat sessions. Use the native **Users**, **Sessions**, **Events**, **Funnels**, **User Flows**, and **Cohorts** panes for the full portal experience.

## Six-step conversion funnel
The generator intentionally mixes completion, abandonment, payment decline, support escalation, and repeat visits.

content.query: let steps=datatable(Step:int,EventName:string)[1,'CustomerJourneyStarted',2,'CatalogViewed',3,'ProductSelected',4,'CartUpdated',5,'CheckoutStarted',6,'PurchaseCompleted']; let observations=customEvents | where name in ('CustomerJourneyStarted','CatalogViewed','ProductSelected','CartUpdated','CheckoutStarted','PurchaseCompleted') | extend User=iff(isempty(user_AuthenticatedId),user_Id,user_AuthenticatedId) | summarize Users=dcount(User),Sessions=dcount(session_Id),Events=count() by EventName=name; steps | join kind=leftouter observations on EventName | project Step,EventName,Users=coalesce(Users,0),Sessions=coalesce(Sessions,0),Events=coalesce(Events,0) | order by Step asc
content.title: Customer conversion funnel

content.json:
## Cohort and experiment conversion
Compare new, returning, and premium synthetic users across experience variants A and B.

content.query: let starts=customEvents | where name=='CustomerJourneyStarted' | extend Segment=tostring(customDimensions['customer.segment']),Variant=tostring(customDimensions['journey.variant']),User=iff(isempty(user_AuthenticatedId),user_Id,user_AuthenticatedId) | summarize StartedUsers=dcount(User),StartedSessions=dcount(session_Id) by Segment,Variant; let purchases=customEvents | where name=='PurchaseCompleted' | extend Segment=tostring(customDimensions['customer.segment']),Variant=tostring(customDimensions['journey.variant']),User=iff(isempty(user_AuthenticatedId),user_Id,user_AuthenticatedId) | summarize ConvertedUsers=dcount(User),ConvertedSessions=dcount(session_Id) by Segment,Variant; starts | join kind=leftouter purchases on Segment,Variant | extend ConvertedUsers=coalesce(ConvertedUsers,0),ConvertedSessions=coalesce(ConvertedSessions,0) | extend UserConversionPct=round(100.0*ConvertedUsers/StartedUsers,1),SessionConversionPct=round(100.0*ConvertedSessions/StartedSessions,1) | project Segment,Variant,StartedUsers,ConvertedUsers,UserConversionPct,StartedSessions,ConvertedSessions,SessionConversionPct | order by Segment asc,Variant asc
content.title: Conversion by segment and A/B variant

content.json:
## Observed flow transitions
Use this table to corroborate the native User Flows visualization and identify support detours or abandonment points.

content.query: let journey=union (pageViews | where name startswith 'Customer /' | project timestamp,session_Id,user_Id,user_AuthenticatedId,Event=name,ItemType='pageView'),(customEvents | where name in ('CustomerJourneyStarted','CatalogViewed','ProductSelected','CartUpdated','SupportRequested','AgentResolutionViewed','CheckoutStarted','PaymentDeclined','PurchaseCompleted') | project timestamp,session_Id,user_Id,user_AuthenticatedId,Event=name,ItemType='customEvent'); journey | extend User=iff(isempty(user_AuthenticatedId),user_Id,user_AuthenticatedId) | order by session_Id asc,timestamp asc | serialize | extend NextSession=next(session_Id),NextEvent=next(Event),NextItemType=next(ItemType) | where session_Id==NextSession | summarize Transitions=count(),Users=dcount(User) by Event,ItemType,NextEvent,NextItemType | order by Transitions desc
content.title: Customer journey transitions
